source.rule: A leaf materiel without explicit prelife data and without lower materiel needing prelife may be omitted from Prelife/PrelifeData/PrelifeStructure and automatically inherit operating age from its closest mother.

hypothesis_before_native.explicit-inherit: System/position/item age60; first PM for original physical LRU ID0 begins at h40, then stock spare ID1 replaces it.
hypothesis_before_native.omitted-leaf: Leaf LRU inherits closest mother position's age60 without PL-LRU entries; first original physical ID0 PM should also begin at h40. The Prelife Log's item-line presence is an observation.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both arms exactly roundtrip populated source tables, convert with zero errors and no notes, calculate, preserve GUI PID13340 and registry option NO, and seal source/raw hashes. Warnings limited to inherited event-log #108 and explicit INHERIT ignored-age warning #419; any other warning stops acceptance.

The only source business difference removes the PL-LRU leaf row in each of Prelife, PrelifeData and PrelifeStructure, while the system, position, monitored item PM, replacement stock and mission-free profile remain identical.

The original installed physical item ID0 has first LRU-CAL100 monitored PM at h40 in both arms, with one-hour item PM and physical spare exchange; no missions instantiate. The native Prelife Log item-line presence is recorded, not predeclared.
Each arm reconciles event, system and stock ledgers, with 192 half-hour report bins and terminal one ready system and one stock item.
A separate reviewer independently replays frozen source and raw evidence without importing the author's validation implementation.
limits: One leaf LRU under one explicitly inherited position and one system, one spare, CALHOURS, one seed and first monitored PM only. No general inheritance rule for higher-level omissions or multiple children.
Stocked-item prelife, later item age, missions, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
